info.title: SellerGraph — FISCO BCOS ledger API
info.description: Blockchain system of record for SellerGraph loans (WeBank). Amounts are minor units (fen). Times are RFC3339 or unix seconds. Click **Authorize** and paste the API token if the server sets one.

servers.description: this server (relative, works behind a reverse-proxy sub-path)

get.summary: Backend, block height, contract addresses, role accounts, policy

post.description: Anchors `decision.doc` (kind decision_package) and creates the loan. WeBank-only loans below the officer threshold are approved immediately.

sellerId.description: hashed with refSalt (HMAC-SHA256); never stored in clear

tier.description: 1 = working capital (order based), 2 = growth capital (campaign based)

humanReviewRequired.description: orchestrator trigger; tier-2 above officerThreshold is forced true by the contract

post.description: Required for tier-2 above officerThreshold or when the orchestrator flagged review. `review.doc` is anchored (human_decision).

post.summary: The one payment, straight to suppliers
post.description: Payment lines must sum to the principal. A second disbursement is rejected (409).

post.summary: Record a repayment (sweep, debit, prepayment, recovery)

extRef.description: idempotency key (bank debit / sweep id); a duplicate returns 409

post.description: Shortfall raises a YELLOW alert; with milestone=true the shortfall becomes overdue. Response adds `shortfall`.

post.summary: Mark matured: all remaining debt overdue, RED alert
Restructure: extend maturity, new sweep rate (officer only)

post.description: Late shipment emits a DELIVERY_LATE covenant event. Response adds `onTime`.

post.summary: Flag a payment line with no shipment after its deadline (RED alert)

get.summary: Portfolio totals, per-funder exposure, red alerts, pending reviews

post.description: Provide `content.doc` (hashed canonically) or `contentHash`. Duplicate for the same subject returns 409.

post.summary: Was this exact document anchored? Where and when?

sellerId.description: hashed with refSalt (HMAC-SHA256); never stored in clear

tier.description: 1 = working capital (order based), 2 = growth capital (campaign based)

humanReviewRequired.description: orchestrator trigger; tier-2 above officerThreshold is forced true by the contract

post.summary: Alias of POST /v1/loans/{id}/disburse with loanId in the body
Alias of POST /v1/loans/{id}/repayments with loanId in the body

extRef.description: idempotency key (bank debit / sweep id); a duplicate returns 409

Time.description: RFC3339 string or unix seconds. Omit to use current chain time.

doc.description: JSON document. Hashed canonically (sorted keys, SHA-256) and anchored in the AuditTrail; its hash goes on chain.

text.description: Free text; SHA-256 goes on chain (not anchored).

uri.description: Where the original document is stored (recorded in the anchor event).

Doc.description: Provide ONE of doc, hash or text.

Allocation.description: Repayment split: overdue interest -> overdue principal -> current interest -> principal; excess becomes refundDue.

LoanResponse.description: Transaction result plus the fresh loan snapshot. Some endpoints add fields such as allocation, shortfall, onTime or *Anchor.
